notes: Doc 3 §3 Axis Registry is still 'pending' in source (v0u1p0); trait_axes here lift the §2.7 provisional dispositions. Axis count provisional (~38-44 + 7 meta + ~12 composites). Visual hints are all inferred for pixel-art use; sources describe mechanics, not sprites.

trait_axes.name: Elemental cluster
trait_axes.summary: Flat material/energy axes; continuous-amplitude by default, gradient chosen per context (offensive/defensive/binding/environmental-ambient/transformative/cultivative).

trait_axes.name: Vital cluster
trait_axes.summary: Life, growth, decay and renewal axes. growth/bloom merged into nature; withering merged into decay.

trait_axes.name: Mind cluster
trait_axes.summary: Hierarchical namespace: base mind plus perception/dream/memory/emotional/psychic sub-axes (specialization-lift fallback: mind:perception:listening -> mind:perception -> mind).

trait_axes.name: Spirit / Death / Divinity cluster
trait_axes.summary: Sacred, profane, spirit and celestial axes. divine and infernal provisionally paired-opposite (two axes). radiant/unhallow are surfaces of divine.

trait_axes.name: Ritual / Binding / Oath cluster
trait_axes.summary: Commitment and binding axes; testament/witnessed/settled route to composites.

trait_axes.name: Adjacency / Curse / Hex cluster
trait_axes.summary: hexing and tainted merged into curse; blight separability still open.

trait_axes.name: Hidden / Secret / Negation cluster
trait_axes.summary: Concealment and negation; silenced (acoustic) and unsaid (linguistic) kept flat.

trait_axes.name: Physical cluster (pure namespace)
trait_axes.summary: Always prefixed physical:*; the flat 'physical' is meaningless.

trait_axes.name: Hunt cluster
trait_axes.summary: combat removed (combat is a context, not an axis, OQ-CMP-19); predator is a composite over {hunt, ferocity, force}.

trait_axes.name: Value / Permanence / Time cluster
trait_axes.summary: Economic, duration and change axes.

trait_axes.name: Anomaly / Planar cluster
trait_axes.summary: Reality-instability and absence.

trait_axes.name: Social cluster (pure namespace)
trait_axes.summary: Always prefixed; paired-opposite poles live inside one signed axis (kinship<->exile, wanderlust<->hearth).

trait_axes.name: Meta / Architectural axes
trait_axes.summary: Engine-facing axes, always meta:-prefixed; not gradient-bearing in the standard sense.

trait_axes.name: quality ladder (state-classifier)
trait_axes.summary: Craftsmanship ladder; LEGENDARY = master-of-masters craft.

trait_axes.name: rarity ladder (state-classifier)
trait_axes.summary: Scarcity ladder split from quality (OQ-CMP-12); LEGENDARY = once-per-civilization scarcity.

trait_axes.name: cultivation ladder (state-classifier)
trait_axes.summary: Harvester tier; ADJACENCY_TRANSFORMED is a parallel branch at BEYOND_MASTER level; LEGENDARY requires an ENDEMIC-promoted source (OQ-CMP-23).

trait_axes.name: cultivation:lifecycle (state-classifier)
trait_axes.summary: Five-stage crop lifecycle; BUILDUP and BEYOND_MASTER are the hidden stages.

trait_axes.name: continuity ladder (state-classifier)
trait_axes.summary: Age/establishment of a lineage or adjacency.

trait_axes.name: Adaptation lifecycle (Mechanism 3 states)
trait_axes.summary: Five-state machine for adjacency-adapted materials plus the PERMANENT promotion lock (recursive ENDEMIC).

trait_axes.name: Defensive-trait ladder
trait_axes.summary: Gradient used by inherited defensive traits on any axis (defensive context). Suffixes stay register-distinct per axis (OQ-CMP-13).

trait_axes.name: Context registry (per-context gradient)
trait_axes.summary: Gradient model is selected by context, not by axis (OQ-CMP-02/24): e.g. flame@offensive, flame@defensive.

trait_axes.name: water:clarity tier
trait_axes.summary: Underwater vision tier; Dim Water Sight shifts it one step.

trait_axes.name: Lexical register tags
trait_axes.summary: Register tags for lexical surfaces and procedural naming (Goblin = [formal]+[crude]; Dwarf = [archaic]+[formal]; Elf = [poetic]+[poetic]; Human = [common] w/ occasional [poetic]).

traits.name: Psychic Damage Dampening

traits.name: Pressure Resistance

traits.name: Half-race composed floor

traits.name: flame

traits.name: frost
traits.visual_hint: icicle fringes, rime on shoulders, pale blue tint

traits.name: electric
traits.summary: Canonical axis. candidate promoted to canonical.

traits.name: air
traits.summary: Canonical axis. candidate promoted to canonical.

traits.name: earth:petrification
traits.summary: Canonical axis. provisional placement (basilisk-eye yields stone content).

traits.name: nature
traits.summary: Canonical axis. wild-vitality; growth and bloom merged.
traits.visual_hint: moss on shoulders, leaves/flowers in hair

traits.name: regeneration
traits.summary: Canonical axis. active re-growth (re-creation, not restoration).

traits.name: rebirth
traits.summary: Canonical axis. cyclic renewal, phoenix archetype.

traits.name: preservation
traits.summary: Canonical axis. decay-resistance specifically (narrower than permanence).

traits.name: mind:memory
traits.visual_hint: floating script fragments, faded sepia overlay

traits.name: divine
traits.summary: Canonical axis. holy/sanctified; radiant is its peak [poetic] surface.

traits.name: infernal
traits.summary: Canonical axis. hellish/damned; paired-opposite of divine.

traits.name: spirit
traits.summary: Canonical axis. incorporeal personhood (ghost, wraith, settled thread).

traits.name: celestial:stellar
traits.summary: Canonical axis. stars; annual meteor-shower cycle.

traits.name: devotional
traits.summary: Canonical axis. practice toward divinity; faith/devotion merged.

traits.name: fey
traits.visual_hint: sprite dust sparkles, pointed ears, iridescent wings

traits.name: containment
traits.summary: Canonical axis. binding inward of loose energy.

traits.name: purity
traits.summary: Canonical axis. unalloyed state (distinct from divine).

traits.name: curse
traits.summary: Canonical axis. environmental malefice; hexing/tainted merged.

traits.name: blight
traits.summary: Canonical axis. Blighted Swamp surface (separability open).

traits.name: unsaid
traits.visual_hint: sewn or covered mouth, blank speech glyph

traits.name: permanence
traits.summary: Canonical axis. resistance to change of any kind.

traits.name: cycles
traits.summary: Canonical axis. periodic pattern (lunar, tidal, seasonal).

traits.name: anomaly:tear
traits.visual_hint: rift crack of light across body

traits.name: meta:provenance
traits.summary: Canonical axis. named-history field (storied blade, heirloom).

adjacency_adaptations.name: Spirit-Bound Yew
adjacency_adaptations.visual_hint: dark yew with bound spirit wisps

adjacency_adaptations.name: Curse-Touched Wheat
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: wheat x Cursed Ruins x BUILDUP harvest; nutrition + curse + hexing. Promotes toward Curse-Wheat via recursive ENDEMIC.

adjacency_adaptations.name: Memory-Barley
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: barley x Boneyard x BUILDUP; nutrition + memory + preservation.

adjacency_adaptations.name: Tide-Rice
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: rice x Feral Coast x BUILDUP; nutrition + water + cycles (+salt, depth).

adjacency_adaptations.name: Moon-Corn

adjacency_adaptations.name: Memorial-Soil
adjacency_adaptations.visual_hint: dark soil with faint glyph flecks

adjacency_adaptations.name: Settled-Ghost-Thread
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: Rare yield {memory .6, spirit .5, peace .4}; ghost-process settled during tending.

adjacency_adaptations.name: Root-Deep-Ore
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: Ore quarried only during tending; amplitude 0.7.
adjacency_adaptations.visual_hint: ore chunk laced with root tendrils

adjacency_adaptations.name: Star-Metal
adjacency_adaptations.visual_hint: dark metal with glinting star points

adjacency_adaptations.name: Sprite
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: Endemic fauna; sprite-dust collapses to fey.

adjacency_adaptations.name: Dryad
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: Legendary endemic; dryad-essence = nature + fey + grace.

adjacency_adaptations.name: ambergris-of-deep / anglerfish-lure / kraken-ink

adjacency_adaptations.name: Underwater six-layer adaptation
adjacency_adaptations.adaptation: Body-side layered adaptation: L1 gear, L2 Breath-Holding skill, L3 inherited traits, L4 aquatic sub-race base, L5 cultivation, L6 deep-water domain.
adjacency_adaptations.visual_hint: layered: diving gear -> gills/fins -> aquatic sub-race body

ranks.name: S-Rank
ranks.summary: Any one of quality/rarity/cultivation at LEGENDARY (S-Rank quality).

ranks.name: SSS-Rank composite
ranks.summary: Quality + Rarity + Cultivation LEGENDARY simultaneously. Requires generational specialized play (cannot be looted/found/crafted-from-base). Provisionally display + narrative significance + capability-unlock for S-tier rituals; not a flat multiplier. Also the Pathway A S-Rank threshold in the Aether Library.

ranks.name: BEYOND_MASTER
ranks.summary: ADJACENCY_TRANSFORMED is a parallel branch at this level

ranks.name: LEGENDARY
ranks.summary: harvested from an ENDEMIC-promoted species by a BEYOND_MASTER cultivator

ranks.name: ADJACENCY_TRANSFORMED
ranks.summary: Parallel branch at BEYOND_MASTER level for adjacency-transformed crops (Curse-Touched Wheat etc.); does not lead directly to LEGENDARY.

cultivation_stages.name: BUILDUP
cultivation_stages.summary: Hidden stage; dim_signature accumulation from adjacency; gates BEYOND_MASTER.
cultivation_stages.visual_hint: subtle adjacency-coloured shimmer building on crop

cultivation_stages.name: BEYOND_MASTER
cultivation_stages.summary: Hidden stage: harvested from BUILDUP at the right moment (Beyond-Master Harvesting skill). Quality-tier-equivalent.
cultivation_stages.visual_hint: crop saturated in adjacency colour with glow

world_modes.name: Standard
world_modes.summary: Default recursive-ENDEMIC parameters (trigger 1.0x legendary, baseline 1/3, cap growth 0.3, unlimited promotions).

world_modes.name: Slow Drift
world_modes.summary: buildup_rate x0.5; trigger_amplitude x1.2; cap_growth x0.5.

world_modes.name: Mythic World
world_modes.summary: buildup_rate x2.0; trigger x0.8; cap_growth x0.5; promotions_hard_cap = 50.

world_modes.name: Fixed World
world_modes.summary: promotions_hard_cap = 0; no recursive ENDEMIC (once-and-done or no promotion).

world_modes.name: Player-Configurable
world_modes.summary: Sliders exposed: endemic_trigger_amplitude, endemic_baseline_fraction, cap_growth_per_promotion, buildup_rate_multiplier, endemic_promotions_hard_cap, cultivation_legendary_unlock_condition.
